_comment: Profile seeding. Three of these guards stand between a config file and an unbootable board: the offset agreement check, its refusal to become a no-op, and the refusal to overwrite answers the user wrote by hand. The fourth - the seed name whitelist - stands between a browser and reading an arbitrary file off the printer.
